title: 1971 Vintage Rothenburg en Tauber German Collectible Christmas Plate Augustus
descriptionText: This is a vintage 1971 collector plate from Rothenburg en Tauber, Germany. The round porcelain plate has a diameter of 7.75 inches and features a blue and white design with a Christmas theme depicting Augustus. It is part of the Rothenburg en Tauber product line and is considered a decorative piece in the Art Pottery production style.
